messages:
Rajat S: Quick sync: product wants a safe, observable deprecation flow for v1 per-route. Goals: no surprise invoices, clear telemetry, and ops safeback. Thoughts?
Tori L: agree. separate modes: preview (no billing/quota impact), staged (gradual weights), and cutover (full). preview should produce an estimated cost and a small sample of outputs.
Mark G: telemetry needs: tag=deprecation_mode, cohort, route_id, tenant_id. metrics: deprecation.preview.cost_est, deprecation.live.cost_delta, deprecation.latency.p95_delta, deprecation.quality.regress_pct.
Anya B: console copy: banner shows status + small "Run preview" button. preview modal includes est cost +/-CI, top 3 affected endpoints, and a redaction notice. also a toggle to opt into sticky sessions for the preview.
Rajat S: routing plan: router checks header X-Client-Version, then route.deprecation.state. preview -> sample routed to v2 for pricing/quality measurement but primary stays v1. staged -> increase v2 weight by step every N minutes.
Tori L: safety: do NOT count preview samples against hard quotas. but surface a preview_quota_estimate metric. if live rollout causes p95 +50ms or regress_pct > 2% for 10m, auto-pause and notify owner + ops.
Mark G: infra: add a lightweight preview job that replays anonymized request metadata through cost/quality models. avoid storing PII. create temporary dashboard when preview starts.
Anya B: UX ask: warn big tenants with "This preview may take longer due to your traffic volume" and require explicit confirmation.
infra-bot: NOTE: audit events emitted: route.deprecation.change, route.deprecation.preview.started, route.deprecation.preview.completed.
Rajat S: action items: Mark-> metrics + preview job spike, Tori-> modal copy + opt-in behavior, Anya-> console warning copy, Rajat-> runbook for auto-pause. Target alpha behind flag in 3w.
Tori L: I'll mock modal by Monday.
Mark G: will open RFC for metric names today.
Rajat S: thanks all, will file tickets and link here. end.
